# A network of rural clinics is losing patients somewhere between the referral and the follow-up visit, and the team has not yet agreed where the loss actually happens

A network of rural clinics is losing patients somewhere between the referral and the follow-up visit, and the team has not yet agreed where the loss actually happens. This room holds four angles on the same ill-defined problem: the visit sequence itself, how patients physically get to a clinic, whether patients trust the system enough to come back, and who on staff is actually doing the follow-up work.
